---
title: Dry Egg Tagliatelle
id: MAR-0042
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g dry egg tagliatelle
- 6 tablespoons grated Grana Padano
- 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 2 whole eggs
- 1 egg yolk
- to taste olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a large bowl, add the egg yolk and the Grana Padano, then season with salt and pepper.
2. Beat with a fork, then gradually add the flour, continuing to stir.
3. Cook the tagliatelle in lightly salted boiling water; drain them, pour them into the bowl with the eggs and mix.
4. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan with a diameter of 13 cm.
5. Using a ladle and a large fork, pour some of the mixture into the hot oil.
6. After a few minutes, turn the frittella with a spatula and let it brown, then place it on paper towels.
7. Heat another tablespoon of oil and continue with more frittelle until all the ingredients are used up.
